text:
nina: FYI Zephyr Labs (acct 7710) responded to our third dunning note. they dispute a line on INV-2026-019 — claim a duplicated embedding batch. attached CSV of their usage they pulled.

raj: can you paste the exact invoice line theylagged? i'll cross-check token/embedding aggregates.

nina: they circled:

```
INV-2026-019
Date: 2026-03-22
Total: $9,320.00
1) Platform subscription: $5,000.00
2) Embeddings (bulk): $3,000.00
3) Embeddings (one-off batch): $620.00  <-- they say duplicate
4) Overages/tax: $700.00
```

kevin: pulling usage for 2026-03-21 to 03-22. quick check: i see batch_1134 processed twice because ingestion webhook retried, created two usage events. looks like double-record for that one-off batch.

zephyr-billing-bot: automated: dunning reminder (final) sent to billing@zephyrlabs.com on 2026-03-24 09:02 UTC for INV-2026-019.

raj: please pause collections until we confirm — don't want to escalate mistakenly. nina, can you ask them for the CSV snippet as plain text? the screenshot is tough to parse.

nina: asked and they pasted the CSV lines. thanks kevin for flag. estimated duplicate amount = $620. recommend crediting that line.

kevin: recommendation: create credit memo CM-2026-021 for $620 and apply to invoice, then regenerate INV-2026-019-R1. also add an audit note referencing job ids batch_1134 and batch_1134-retry.

raj: +1. also waive the standard late fee for this cycle and pause automated escalation emails. offer a 3-part payment plan for the remaining balance to help them close.

nina: confirmed — created CM-2026-021 and applied. new balance $8,700. invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-019-R1 (shows credit pending reconciliation). created ticket ZD-4599 to track correspondence.

zephyr-billing-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-019 by collections (raj) at 2026-03-24 11:18 UTC.

nina: replying to Zephyr: we identified the duplicated embedding batch and issued a $620 credit. we
lso propose a 3-installment plan (due now, +30d, +60d) with no late fees for this cycle. please confirm which option you prefer. cc'ing your AM.

zephyr (via email paste): appreciate quick triage. can we do 2 installments instead? hope you can confirm updated invoice and schedule.

kevin: accept 2-installment request (50/50) this time as a one-off. document waiver and terms in ZD-4599. include payment link and remittance instructions.

raj: note for records: credit < $1k so collections discretion ok. log internal reason = ingestion webhook retry double-record. create ENG ticket to fix dedupe logic.

nina: opened ENG-9001 (ingestion dedupe) and assigned to eng-runtime. included job ids and replication steps.

raj: logged calendar follow-up for 2026-04-23 to verify installment cleared. if they miss, escalate to account executive and re-open dunning. :eyes: 

nina: all set. closing thread after Zephyr confirms payment plan. thanks team.
